title: Evaluation of Massage Therapy for Cancer Related Fatigue in Breast Cancer Survivors
official: Mechanism Anchored Evaluation of Short Course Massage Therapy for Cancer Related Fatigue in Breast Cancer Survivors: A Waitlist Controlled Pilot Trial
summary: The purpose of this study is to better understand how massage therapy helps reduce fatigue related to cancer and its treatment in breast cancer survivors.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Ability to understand and willingness to sign an IRB-approved informed consent
2. Age ≥ 18 years at the time of consent
3. Self-reported fatigue, as documented by the treating clinician
4. Patient with stage 0 - III breast cancer actively being treated for their diagnosis
5. Score of ≤ 10 on Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9)
6. Will refrain from receiving any massage therapy treatments outside of the study for the duration of study participation
7. Available for massage therapy on Mondays and Wednesdays

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Any documented, clinically significant cardiac-related abnormality that would deem massage therapy unsafe as per enrolling investigator
2. Participation in another clinical trial that is interventional or related to fatigue
3. Already receiving massage therapy clinically and/or personally
